summary: Two-story 'smokehouse' lookout built 1929 on Sedge Ridge (Yakima Co.), staffed in 1958, abandoned 1961; a small communications building is on the summit.

facts.design: two-story ground cabin, nicknamed a smokehouse
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1961; the register says it is now gone and firelookout.com says it has since been removed. A small communications building is on the summit.

access.note: Drive-up route through Ahtanum State Forest roads per Willhite; timber harvest could change road access.

visit.trail_note: Reached by the 2400 road from Ahtanum Road; higher clearance is advised on one dirt route.

events.note: Two-story lookout built in 1929; announced in a Division of Forestry annual report
Mt. Adams Sun item of 21 Aug 1958 profiles a young woman working the lookout that summer
Abandoned; register says now gone, firelookout.com says since removed
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, August 15, 2012

notes_for_editor: Build year (1929) and abandonment (1961) agree across all four sources. The 1958 staffing comes from a Mt. Adams Sun item as quoted on the Weebly and Willhite pages; the newspaper itself was not read, and the story does not name the woman. The 'smokehouse' nickname and the Tom Bigley recollection are as quoted by the register and Willhite. The Willhite communications-building note is in photos from 2019; the story says the page reports it without giving a date for the building. Public access is inferred from the drive-up description; no gate was described. Story uses none of the Willhite photos because no licence or direct image URL was confirmed.
